observations: Third-reader verified inventory. All 4 original screenshots, the 4 pre-rendered criteria zooms, the 4 list zooms and 13 extra renders (prefix c in the zoom folder: 5x-20x crops of the title bar, every section header, picker, dropdown and date box, plus a histogram-equalised copy of each full screenshot) were read. Readers A and B agreed on every report, section, control, option, default value, enabled state and truncation flag (4 reports, 19 controls); they differed only in the wording of notes. Everything was nevertheless re-checked on the pixels: the selected radio located in each file (left list, PDF, Office), fill colours of every box and button, and an exact-colour sweep of each criteria box (every pixel that is not one of the flat background colours, grouped into connected regions) which returned only the elements listed here - no 'Page Break' or other checkbox, no right-edge or second-column extras, no greyed-out control, no instruction or legend text, no scrollbar, no footer text. COVERAGE: 4 screenshots = 4 different reports, each selected exactly once, in list order: 1.PNG Provider List, 2.PNG Provider Holidays, 3.PNG Provider Operatory, 4.PNG Provider Registration. All are the normal two-panel screen in its default state - no popup, no expanded dropdown, no scrolled second view, no foreign screen - so the dialogs behind the SELECT buttons (office / office group, provider) and the option lists of the SPECIALTY and STATE dropdowns are NOT documented by this category. TITLE BAR (identical in all 4): 'Provider List Reports' at the left; 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a white printer icon (icon only, no text) at the far right. LEFT PANEL: blue header bar 'SELECT REPORT', then exactly four radio rows in a SINGLE column (no second column), each closed by a thin white rule; everything below the fourth row is uniform navy (pixel-exact) down to the bottom edge, so the list is neither clipped nor scrollable. A dark tab with three vertical dots on the border between the two panels is the splitter / collapse handle. RIGHT PANEL: blue header bar 'REPORT CRITERIA' with the CLEAR CRITERIA button (refresh icon) at its right end - drawn slate-grey (RGB 112,127,140) in every screenshot while all other buttons are blue (41,134,220), which is its normal styling in this application, not a disabled state; a bordered criteria box built from grey section-header bars; a footer bar inside the box with blue PRINT / PREVIEW (printer icon) and ADD TO MY FAVORITES (plus icon) right-aligned. The same three actions appear on every report. No criteria panel is truncated: each shows the footer bar and the bottom border of its box, and in 1.PNG and 2.PNG the lower edge line of the page frame is visible under it. PATTERNS: every report starts with PRINT FORMAT = PDF (default) / Excel and OFFICE/GROUP = Office (default) / Office Group radios plus an unlabelled read-only office box showing 108 (= the OID in the title bar) with a SELECT button (building icon). Provider List, Provider Holidays and Provider Operatory add a PROVIDER section in a right-hand column beside OFFICE/GROUP (row label 'Provider', read-only box ALL, SELECT button with single-person icon); Provider Registration has NO provider filter and its OFFICE/GROUP header spans the full width. Only Provider List has SPECIALTY and STATE (side-by-side dropdowns, both ALL, collapsed). Only Provider Holidays has a date range, under the header text 'LAST VISIT DATE RANGE' (odd for a holidays report - apparently a reused header - kept exactly as displayed), with Start Date and End Date both 11/21/2026 (the capture day). Pickers are a read-only grey box (fill RGB 220,223,226) plus a blue SELECT button; dropdowns and date boxes have the light editable fill (241,241,241), so every control in this category is enabled. There is no REPORT FORMAT, DATE RANGE (plain), PATIENT TYPE, OTHER OPTIONS, GROUP BY or SORT BY section anywhere in this category. FONT NOTE: the capital G of the header font renders almost like a C at screenshot resolution (headers look like 'OFFICE/CROUP' and 'LAST VISIT DATE RANCE'); both were confirmed as G on the pixels - the glyph is darker at its lower right (the G spur) whereas the true C of OFFICE in the same header is exactly symmetric top/bottom - and the mixed-case radio label 'Office Group' is unambiguous. Screenshot sizes vary slightly (1.PNG 1366x588, 2.PNG 1363x587, 3.PNG 1365x584, 4.PNG 1365x582) with the content shifted 1-3 px vertically between files; this is a capture detail, not a different state.

reports.name: Provider List
reports.notes: 1.PNG only (left-list radio 'Provider List' filled). Layout top to bottom: PRINT FORMAT (full width); OFFICE/GROUP (left half) + PROVIDER (right half) side by side, with the office box + SELECT on a full-width row under the radios; SPECIALTY (left half) + STATE (right half) side by side. The only report of the category with SPECIALTY and STATE filters; both dropdowns are collapsed, so only their current value ALL is known. Below them the criteria box is blank down to the footer bar (exact-colour sweep and a histogram-equalised render found nothing else: no checkbox, no Page Break, no instruction text). The footer bar with PRINT / PREVIEW and ADD TO MY FAVORITES and the bottom border of the box are fully visible and there is no scrollbar - not truncated. No greyed-out control; the picker boxes are grey only because they are read-only.

dynamic_rules.effect: The SELECT picker chooses office groups defined in Setup > Office Groups (for example regions) instead of offices; when no office groups are defined, a group run covers all offices of the account. Cross-cutting statement of the document for all Lists screens (vendor articles on office groups and on the new reports menu) - recorded once here; it applies to all four Provider List reports.
dynamic_rules.evidence_quote: `Office Group` picks groups defined in `Setup > Office Groups` (for example regions); without groups a group run covers all offices of the account.

corrections.text: The number in the office box is not a fixed default: with the Office radio the box defaults to the current office (the OID of the session, the same number the title bar shows) and SELECT picks other offices. Recorded once here; it applies to the office box of all four Provider List reports.

supplement_unresolved.question: SPECIALTY and STATE dropdowns: the value lists are not documented (only the default ALL is known). Which provider field does STATE read (the state of the provider address is assumed), and which assignment does OFFICE/GROUP read (the Works At offices are assumed)?
What do the two dates under the re-used header LAST VISIT DATE RANGE match? "Holidays or exceptions intersecting the range" is only the document's reading; no vendor description of the report exists.

Provider Registration: no vendor page uses the term, so what the report covers (provider registration numbers per office, or enrolment with connected services) is unknown. Its criteria are OFFICE/GROUP only and nothing can be added until a generated sample is obtained.

No vendor article describes any of the four Provider List reports: what PROVIDER and OFFICE/GROUP relate to on Provider Holidays and Provider Operatory is inferred from the provider setup screens only.
